winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里

经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现

subtitles.zh: 卡尼总理，感谢您抽时间与我们坐下来交谈。谢谢，布莱恩。
subtitles.en: Prime Minister Karni, thank you for taking the time to sit down with us. Thanks for doing this, Brian.

subtitles.zh: 我们正在多伦多参加首届加拿大**峰会。
subtitles.en: So we're in Toronto for the first ever Canada Investment Summit.

subtitles.zh: 您邀请了全球资管领域的众多顶级机构，主权财富基金、**公司、资管机构。
subtitles.en: You've got many of the biggest names in the world in terms of money management here, sovereign wealth funds, investment firms, asset managers.

subtitles.zh: 您还准备了一份项目清单供他们审阅。加拿大基础设施、矿业、石油、天然气、清洁技术、数据中心。
subtitles.en: And you've got a deal book for them to look through. Canadian infrastructure, mines, oil, gas, clean technology, data centers.

subtitles.zh: 我听说您深度参与了此次峰会的筹划。
subtitles.en: I'm told you we're quite involved in the planning of this.

subtitles.zh: 请谈谈您的推介。为什么这对您是个重要优先事项？我认为加拿大是全球联系最紧密的经济体之一。
subtitles.en: Give us your pitch. Why was this a big priority for you? Well, look, I think Canada is one of the most connected economies in the world.

subtitles.zh: 我们的贸易协定覆盖15亿消费者。
subtitles.en: We have trade deals covering one and a half billion consumers.

subtitles.zh: 我们的养老金基金和金融机构深度参与对其他国家的**。
subtitles.en: Our pension funds, our financial institutions are very involved in investing in other countries.

subtitles.zh: 我们希望互惠。你们希望更大规模地欢迎外国资本，带来能源、理念和资本。
subtitles.en: We want reciprocity. You want to welcome foreign capital here in a bigger scale, bringing energy, ideas, capital

subtitles.zh: 是的。我们这里确实有资本，但存在不同视角。
subtitles.en: yes. We do have capital here, but there's different perspectives.

subtitles.zh: 过去一年半我们也做了不少重大调整。
subtitles.en: We also have been making some big changes over the course of the last year and a half.

subtitles.zh: 现在是重新审视加拿大市场的好时机。过去一年我们发现，海外资本对加拿大的配置明显不足。
subtitles.en: Now's the time to look at Canada fresh. And one of the things that we've discovered over the course of the last year is that foreign capital is under allocated to Canada.

subtitles.zh: 在彭博台上我可以直说，加拿大市场并未达到市场基准权重。
subtitles.en: It's not, I mean, we're on Bloomberg, so I can say that it's not market weight to Canada.

subtitles.zh: 因此，哪怕只是向市场基准权重靠拢，也会带来大量资金流入。
subtitles.en: So even a shift to market weight to Canada will create a tremendous inflow of capital.

subtitles.zh: 这将帮助我们实现经济所需，也就是在未来五年催化约一万亿美元的资本投入。
subtitles.en: And it's going to help us realize what we think this economy needs, which is to catalyze about a trillion dollars of investment over the next five years.

subtitles.zh: 那么加拿大为何被低配？您怎么诊断？
subtitles.en: So why is Canada underweight? What's your diagnosis?

Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
